name: Covarion.Huelsenbeck02Two
title: Two-regime Huelsenbeck covarion model

args.name: r1
args.description: The sum of the OFF-to-ON and ON-to-OFF rates in regime 1

args.name: r2
args.description: The sum of the OFF-to-ON and ON-to-OFF rates in regime 2

args.name: pi1
args.description: The equilibrium fraction of time spent ON in regime 1

args.name: pi2
args.description: The equilibrium fraction of time spent ON in regime 2

args.name: fraction1
args.description: The fraction of sites in regime 1

description:
Mixes two Huelsenbeck ON/OFF covarion regimes. A fraction fraction1 of sites uses r1 and pi1; the remaining sites use r2 and pi2. Both regimes use the same base substitution model or rate mixture. Sites retain their regime throughout the tree, but switch between ON and OFF within that regime.

The computed switchingDist reports the equilibrium ON/OFF switching rates of the two regimes, weighted by their fractions of sites, before overall substitution-rate normalization.
